name: Duo Storia
source:
Neshika, a “Creation Magician” who can transmute mana into matter, travels the world with her younger brother Elmano, a self-proclaimed “genius alchemist.”
However, Elmano, who is supposed to be a genius, fails at a spell and accidentally crystallizes part of his power.

Their adventure continues as the sister and brother seek the scattered fragments of Elmano across the world caused by the runaway magic.
translation:
内西卡是一位能够将魔力转化为物质的“创造魔法师”，她与自称“天才炼金术士”的弟弟艾尔马诺一起环游世界。
然而，被认为是天才的艾尔马诺却在咒语上失败了，意外地结晶了自己的部分力量。

他们的冒险仍在继续，姐弟俩寻找因失控的魔法而散落在世界各地的埃尔马诺碎片。
